audio.description: Procedural sound bank and game-side mixing. The sim never reads it.

jumpsquat.description: Frames crouching before takeoff. Jump still held on the last one = full hop, released = short hop.

airDrag.description: Air drift when no direction is held (multiplier per frame).

airDragHeld.description: Air drift multiplier when a direction is held but already at max speed.

fastFallMinVy.description: Fast fall allowed once vertical speed is above this (negative = still slightly rising; y down).

fastFallKick.description: Downward speed applied the frame you fast fall.

attackFriction.description: Ground friction multiplier during attacks; `slide` frames use attackSlideFriction.

attackAirDrag.description: Air drift multiplier during attacks when not accelerating.

platformDrop.description: Frames platforms are ignored after dropping through.

pushRadius.description: Fighters overlapping closer than this push apart.

dashAttackSpeed.description: Ground speed needed for attack → dash attack and grab → dash grab.

tapWindow.description: Frames a direction press counts as a "tap" for smash attacks, rolls and spot dodges.

bReverseWindow.description: Frames after a `bReverse` move starts in which pressing the other direction turns it around.

Movement.description: Shared movement rules. Per-fighter speeds and gravity live in each fighter's `stats`.

bufferFrames.description: Human press buffer lifetime in ticks (inclusive); 0 disables re-delivery.

InputRules.description: Digital stick interpretation; history is part of the rollback snapshot.

separateCosmeticRng.description: Keep effect ranges and charge particles from advancing gameplay randomness.

techMinSpeed.description: Minimum downward landing speed to tech or enter knockdown from tumble.

hitstunParticleSpeed.description: Speed above which hitstun emits alternate-frame trail particles.

SimRules.description: Shared simulation constants retained from the reference implementation.

thresholds.description: Named thresholds for the fixed, shared decision tree (not fighter/move identities).

AiRules.description: CPU decision thresholds in reference branch order. Arrays are indexed by difficulty (0..2).

surfaceChaseTicks.description: No-progress ticks before committing to a jump across surfaces. Zero disables it for reference traces.

AiThresholds.description: Geometry, timing, and probability thresholds for the shared CPU decision tree.

tumbleThreshold.description: Knockback above this sends the victim tumbling (can tech, lands in knockdown).

groundBounce.description: Hitting a grounded victim downward bounces them up at this fraction.

chargeKbRatio.description: Fraction of the charge damage bonus that also applies to base knockback.

driftAccel.description: Horizontal drift you can add while in hitstun (per frame).

Hitstun.description: Hitstun = floor(knockback × perKnockback) + base, then per-hitbox hitstunMult/hitstunAdd.

Hitlag.description: Hitlag (freeze frames for both fighters) = min(max, floor(base + damage × perDamage + knockback × perKnockback)).

TripRule.description: Grounded victim knocked prone: slide speed away from the attacker.

SakuraiRule.description: Auto angle: grounded hits below tumble knockback use groundLow, stronger grounded hits groundHigh, airborne hits air.

AutolinkRule.description: Victim velocity = (hitbox center − victim center) × pull + attacker velocity × momentum.

WindboxRule.description: Push per frame = bkb × push × victim weight, capped at maxSpeed.

decay.description: Shield HP lost per frame while held.

regen.description: Shield HP regained per frame while not shielding.

damageMult.description: Shield HP lost = damage × damageMult × hitbox.shieldDmgMult.

attackerPushback.description: Attacker's own pushback on a shielded grounded hit.

dropLag.description: Frames of lag after releasing shield.

dizzyBase.description: Dizzy duration = max(dizzyMin, dizzyBase − percent × dizzyPerPercent).

dizzyMash.description: Frames removed from dizzy per button press.

dizzyRecoverHP.description: Shield HP after recovering from dizzy.

hard.description: Landing lag from a normal fall faster than softLandSpeed.

window.description: Press shield within this many frames before landing in tumble to tech.

minFrames.description: Frames lying down before you can act.

autoGetup.description: Automatically stand up at this frame.

end.description: Last active phase frame (inclusive). Omit to stay active until the phase ends.

x.description: Offset forward from the feet. Negative = behind.

kbg.description: Knockback growth: knockback added per victim percent.

angle.description: Launch angle in degrees. 0 = forward, 90 = straight up, negative = down.

setKb.description: Fixed knockback: ignores the victim's percent (knockback = bkb × weight).

rehit.description: Multi-hit: can hit the same victim again every this many frames (default: once per phase).

hitstunMult.description: Multiplies the hitstun this box causes.

counterDamage.description: Counter strike: damage comes from the countered hit (see `Counter`). Inactive if nothing was countered.

frames.description:
Per-frame position/size `[frame, x, y, r]`. A frame without an entry uses the closest earlier entry, or
x/y/r before the first entry. Omit for a box that stays put.

Hitbox.description:
A hit circle. In a move phase, `start`/`end` are inclusive phase frames. For throws, projectiles and other
hits that aren't frame-windowed they are ignored. When two boxes overlap a victim, the first listed wins.

oneOf.description: Away from the attacker's center (multi-direction hits).
Always launches downward (a positive `angle` is mirrored below the horizon).
Grounded victims are knocked prone instead of launched. Airborne victims are hit normally.
Angle chosen automatically: flat on weak grounded hits, higher on strong ones, 45° in the air (`global.hitTypes.sakurai`).
Pulls the victim toward the hitbox center, plus the attacker's momentum. For multi-hit moves (`rehit`).
No damage, hitstun or hitlag. Pushes anything it touches every frame along `angle` (strength = bkb).
Longer victim hitlag (`global.hitTypes.electric`), with spark effects.

minHang.description: Frames hanging before you can act.

mashPerPress.description: Hold frames removed per victim button press.

minHold.description: Frames before the grabber can pummel or throw.

alphaGamma.description:
Translucent colors' alpha is raised to this power. The GPU blends in linear light, which makes faint
overlays much stronger than the sRGB (canvas) blending the art was tuned for. 2.2 matches sRGB blending
over black, 1 is plain linear blending; ~1.6 suits this game's dark-but-not-black scenes.

padTop.description: Padding above the fighters' feet (include the body height).

minHeight.description: Zoom limits as visible height in stage pixels: `minHeight` = closest zoom, `maxHeight` = widest.

referencePlayWidth.description: Reference play-area width before camera padding; the bundled value is Arena’s play area.

referencePlayHeight.description: Reference play-area height (including block undersides), before camera padding; the bundled value is Arena’s play area.

minScaleStart.description: Only stages smaller than this fraction of both reference dimensions zoom in tighter.

minScaleFloor.description: Smallest automatic minHeight multiplier; scaling below minScaleStart is linear.

stageBias.description: 0..1: how far the framing center is pulled toward the stage's center (keeps the stage in view).

blastMargin.description: Fighters are framed no further than this outside the blast zone (keeps KO'd fighters from yanking it).

follow.description: Fraction of the remaining distance covered per tick, for position and zoom. 1 = no smoothing.

shakeDecay.description: Screen shake (stage pixels): multiplied by `shakeDecay` each tick, cut off below `shakeMin`.

Camera.description:
Follow camera. Each tick it frames every fighter that's on screen-worthy (not dead/out), padded, keeps the
window's aspect ratio, and eases toward that framing. It never shows past the stage's `camera` bounds.

runSpeed.description: Grounded `idle` fighters moving faster than this (px/tick) use the `run` animation.

glowAlpha.description: Opacity of the soft glow under the figure.

flash.description: Body color while flashing from a hit.

helpless.description: Body and back-limb colors while helpless.

hitJitter.description: Random sideways jitter (px) while in hitlag after being hit.

blinkPeriod.description: Invincibility blinking after respawn: alpha `alpha` every other `period` ticks.

xEyeWidth.description: Line width of the X eyes (knocked down, dizzy).

ChargeLook.description: Smash charge look: body blinks to `color` every `blink` ticks, jitters, and glows.

spacing.description: Ghost k sits `k × spacing` ticks of velocity behind.

ghostAlpha.description: Nearest ghost's opacity; each further ghost fades by the same step.

DodgeLook.description: Dodging (invulnerable roll, spot dodge, air dodge, tech): pale body, ghosts behind along the velocity.

stunAlpha.description: Fill opacity during shield stun (the outline turns white too).

ShieldLook.description: Shield bubble: centered `y` above the feet, radius `minR + growR × shield HP / max`.

DizzyLook.description: Stars circling the head while dizzy: an ellipse `rx`×`ry` centered `y` above the feet.

pulse.description: Opacity swing and its speed (degrees per tick).

RespawnLook.description: Glowing platform under a respawning fighter: an ellipse `w`×`h` centered `y` below the feet, pulsing.

TrailLook.description:
Attachment swing trail: covers the last `frames` ticks of the swing, fades out over `fade` ticks after the
hitbox ends.

drag.description: Particle horizontal speed multiplier per tick.

shrink.description: Particles shrink to this fraction of their size by the end of their life.

width.description: Half-width at the far end, growing by `grow` over the beam's life.

bands.description: Bands from the KO point outward, each fading more. The first band is white.

BeamLook.description:
KO blast: a beam from the KO point toward the stage center, sparks and a ring. The point is clamped inside
the view by `inset`.

damageRamp.description: Percent number color by damage: `[percent, color]` stops, interpolated, sorted by percent.

shake.description: Percent number shake (logical px) while the sim's `hudShake` timer runs, scaled by the timer.

endSlowmo.description: When the match ends ("GAME!"), the sim runs at `speed` for its first `ticks` end-freeze ticks.

resultsDelay.description: Ticks the winner pose shows after the match is over, before the results screen.

koCreditTicks.description:
Results stats: a fall counts as a KO for the last hitter if they hit within this many ticks, otherwise
as a self-destruct.

Hud.description: In-match HUD and match-flow presentation (the game crate reads this; the sim never does).

flourish.description: Move slot a fighter plays on the stage when its player locks in, before its `win` pose.

rosterColor.description: Roster tile figures no player is pointing at.

flipSecs.description: Seconds for a card's READY flip and the ready banner's slide-in.

sizeSmall.description:
Stage size labels: play area relative to `camera.referencePlayWidth` / `referencePlayHeight` (the larger
ratio); below `sizeSmall` reads "Small", above `sizeLarge` "Large", otherwise "Medium".

thumbCrop.description: Stage thumbnails show the play area scaled by `[width, height]` (then widened to the tile's aspect).

SelectLook.description: Character select presentation (the game crate reads this; the sim never does).

secs.description: Seconds from the first hop to the landing.

hops.description: Hops before the landing (more distinct votes only change where it starts).

curve.description: Hop `k` of `hops` happens at `secs * (k / hops)^curve`: above 1 the hops slow down.

pause.description: Seconds the landed stage shows before the match starts.

landScale.description: The landed tile's scale, plus a bounce of `landBounce` (fading out over the pause) bouncing `landWobble` radians over the pause.

Roulette.description: Stage select vote roulette: a highlight hops over the voted stages, slowing down, and lands on the winner.

speed.description:
Analog stick: top speed at full tilt, stick response exponent (above 1 is finer near the centre), and how
fast the velocity follows the stick (per second; also how fast it brakes on release).

deadzone.description: Stick tilt below this is released.

magnetRadius.description:
The magnet pulls a slow pointer onto the nearest target within `magnetRadius` of its centre (any distance once
the stick is released), at `magnetStrength` per second. It starts below `magnetSpeed` of the top speed and is
full strength at rest.

reach.description: A gliding pointer hovers targets up to this far outside their edges.

slideSecs.description: Digital presses hop to the neighbouring target, sliding there in this many seconds.

fan.description:
Pointers resting on one target fan out by this much per player (at most a fifth of its width), from `rest` of
its height above its centre (so the chip riding on the arrow stays clear of a tile's name).

land.description:
Squash and bounce when a pointer lands (`land`) or drops a chip (`drop`): scale amplitude, fading out over
`bounceSecs` while wobbling `bounceWobble` radians per second.

stroke.description: Stroke thickness and size scale of the arrow.

PointerLook.description: Select screens' player pointers. Units are logical UI pixels (the screen is 720 high) and seconds.

lean.description: Leans into its horizontal travel by `lean` radians per pixel per second, at most `leanMax`.

stretch.description:
Stretches along its travel by `stretch` per pixel per second, at most `stretchMax`; springing back past rest
squashes it as it stops.

chipSpring.description:
A carried chip trails behind on a spring, softly limited to `chipLag` pixels away, and swings `chipSwing`
radians per pixel of sideways lag.

stillSpeed.description:
Still (below `stillSpeed` pixels per second) for `breathAfter` seconds, it breathes: a bob of `breathBob`
pixels and a `breathScale` swell every `breathSecs`, fading in over a second, each player out of phase.

PointerMotion.description:
How a pointer reacts to its motion. Springs have a stiffness (per second squared) and a damping ratio (1 is
critical, lower swings).

HintLook.description:
Per-card control hints: shown for `showSecs` after joining, after `idleSecs` without input, and while the
player points at their own card; fading in and out over `fadeSecs`.

defaults.description: Starting slider values, each 0..1. Saved settings override these.

maxVoices.description: Maximum simultaneous voices, including sounds still waiting for an audio device.

maxPerFrame.description: Maximum new voices per rendered frame.

cooldown.description: Minimum wall-clock seconds between repeats of the same sound.

pan.description: Screen-space emitter displacement relative to listener ears; 0 disables panning.

depth.description: Listener-to-emitter depth in normalized screen units (keeps attenuation mild).

earGap.description: Stereo listener ear separation in normalized screen units.

pitchVariation.description: Local pitch variation as a fraction (0..0.5), independent of sim RNG and training speed.

strengthLevels.description: Number of pre-synthesized strength levels per sound, 1..16.

strengthMax.description: Knockback/damage at which a scaled sound reaches full strength.

sounds.description: Sound names referenced by sim/content and UI. Unknown names are skipped with a warning.

music.description: Reserved for future music; currently silent.

priority.description: Higher priorities win frame and voice limits (KO > hit > movement).

cooldown.description: Additional minimum real seconds between repeats.

strengthDuration.description: Duration multiplier at maximum impact (interpolated from 1).

strengthGain.description: Gain multiplier at minimum impact (interpolated to 1).

from.description: Exponential frequency sweep in Hz. For noise, a swept one-pole low-pass cutoff.

decay.description: Exponential amplitude decay factor over the layer.
